name: Matrimony.com Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, Matrimony.com Ltd provides matchmaking services and marriage services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) Matrimony.com is the largest matchmaking service provider in India. 
b) The company offers diversified 
online matchmaking services to both
 online and offline to cater to the unique requirements of Indian-origin consumers
 like regional, community, and also tailor 
made services for the elite.
c) It also provides an asset-light vendor 
 platform for venue bookings, catering, decorations, etc. 
d) Currently, it has a Paid subscription 
 the base of 1 Mn profiles in FY25
e) It differentiates itself from other players 
 in India by following a micro-market strategy, 
offering a range of targeted and customized products and services that are tailored to 
meet the requirements of customers

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 31.3%
Promoter holding has increased by 1.00% over last quarter.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.16% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.30.8 Cr.
